text:
Ana (Sales): Heads-up: Enterprise POC with SummitTech. They asked for SIG/CAIQ, SOC2 link, our IR timeline, and whether we can hold keys for a short POC. Need a short packet by tomorrow 9am PT.

Diego (Security): I9ll draft the SIG/CAIQ answers and IR summary. Key-holding is not our standard for VPC; BYOK is. What exact ask did they make about key escrow?

Ana (Sales): They want us to hold a temporary key during the 30-day POC to make integration easier. Procurement is open to temp custody if we accept limited liability.

Riley (Solutions): From infra side: POC would be VPC with customer-managed KMS by default. If we temporarily hold keys, we need a playbook: limited access, HSM backing, audit logs, and explicit delete after POC. That9s doable but needs Legal + Security sign-off.

Priya (Legal): Key escrow okay only with strict contract terms. We9d require a scoped addendum: limited-purpose use, deletion certificate, increased indemnity, and forensics cooperation clause. Recommend offering BYOK first; escrow as a paid optional add-on.

Diego (Security): IR timeline (short version) to include in packet: detect ack within 1h, triage 0-24h, containment goal 24h, customer notification within 72h of confirmed impact; post-incident report within 14 days. We can include conditional 48h notification for enterprise SLAs with extra controls.

Ana (Sales): Can we commit to 48h in the contract if they accept indemnity terms?

Priya (Legal): Yes, but must be gated. Clause: "Redwood to notify within 48 hours of confirmed data-impacting incident provided customer has accepted higher liability cap and cooperates in forensic activities." I will draft two clause options (72h standard, 48h enterprise).

Riley (Solutions): POC pricing: 4-week POC, 3 GPU nodes, demo dataset only, 30% off standard reserved rate + two enablement sessions. If they want escrow add-on, charge a one-time escrow fee and professional services for key handover/removal.

Diego (Security): SIG notes: I'll mark some controls as "Available in Private only" where applicable and provide compensating controls (audit logs, restricted access). Also attach latest pentest date.

Ana (Sales): Great. Please include SOC2 redacted link and pentest date. SummitTech procurement always asks for proof.

Diego (Security): SOC2 (redacted) link: https://files.redwood/security/soc2-redacted-2026.pdf. Latest pentest: 2026-02-11. Uploading SIG answers now.

ci-bot: ci-bot: File created: https://files.redwood/sales/poc/summit-sig-caiq-answers-1782703456.pdf

Priya (Legal): Draft clauses uploaded to sales/contracts: https://files.redwood/contracts/poc-clause-1782703456.docx. Will add escrow risk bullets and required controls.

Riley (Solutions): I uploaded SOW + pricing to sales/poc: https://files.redwood/sales/poc/summit-sow-1782703456.pdf. Notes on data handling, no production data in POC.

Ana (Sales): Thanks team. I'll assemble the packet and send to SummitTech by 0900 PT. Diego/Priya: please make sure SIG/IR excerpt and legal clauses are in the same bundle.

Diego (Security): Will do. Including contact matrix: security@redwood.ai, ir-oncall@redwood.ai, legal@redwood.ai, comms@redwood.ai.

Priya (Legal): Added deletion certificate language: we provide proof of key destruction within 7 days of POC end if escrow used.

Ana (Sales): Closing loop. If SummitTech pushes for escrow w/out indemnity, we decline and steer to BYOK + managed onboarding. Thanks :slightly_smiling_face:
